summary: contracts/Reservation.ocl#list meets W1 ApplicationPlan dbc apply at standard density: pre PrincipalAuthorized; posts ResultIsFullDumpOfVisibleHolds (sku/quantity/expiresAt/availableStock vs self.holds()@pre), EmptyCollectionWhenNoneVisible, HoldsUnchanged, AvailableStockUnchanged; live UnauthorizedErrorOnList plus no-mutation failure posts. ResultIsFullDumpOfVisibleHolds matches sku, quantity, expiresAt, and current availableStock to self.holds()@pre but does not assert holdId/id equality required by OpenAPI LookupResponse and Brief R2/SC2. Full-dump size and field coverage remain checkable at standard density; holdId binding would strengthen API/OCL symmetry (same polish as lookup ResultIsHoldDetails).

AvailableStockUnchanged (and the unauthorized twin) quantify only over SKUs present in holds@pre; when the visible set is empty the stock-side post is vacuously true. HoldsUnchanged still anchors no-mutation for W1 vocabulary; an explicit forAll over tracked SKUs would be stronger polish, not a missing-pre hole.
